relations_review.basis: Snapshot explicitly ties granularity to current decision and requires causal intervention/mediator evidence. Draft calls this complementary and does not turn a transition into a causal arrow.
Snapshot describes action/measurement/deviation/adjustment and delay. Draft uses periodic prediction checks as input, not claiming stochastic recurrence proves causal feedback.
Runtime distinguishes pre/post observations from justified counterfactual causal inference; matching handoff for campaign attribution.
Runtime requires adaptive participant responses, not merely complex data; draft conditional handoff applies only when people learn/respond to rules.
Runtime handles staged irreversible choices and information availability; draft routes one-off or state-dependent action decisions without equating ordinary chain and optimal policy.

arithmetic.method: Independent exact-rational computation from request counts and duration; review_focus inspected as reviewer but not used as arithmetic authority.
arithmetic.planning_probability_status: Scenario assumptions only; six weeks consistent records and no clear subgroup difference do not establish Markov property or causal intervention effectiveness.

post_week4.A: Only transitions 1-4 specified. Beyond-week4 matrix is unknown. If restored to baseline, same 1600/7 limit; if additionally assumed permanent A, 800/3. Neither continuation is established by four-week effect specification.

action_constraints: Do not combine A and B or treat leftover 20 as authorization for unpriced tests.
Recommendation conditional on effect/cost assumptions; first check feasible execution and measurement in the existing full-cost plan, then compare each week with predictions.
No payment or real intervention executed by this analysis; expected fractional people are not an actual-count guarantee.

cannot_infer: Complete comparable cohort from current registration count 600 while entries/deletions occur.
Number starting inactive and observable next period, or portion of latest-only60 that is returning rather than new.
Full transition table or main-platform exact week8 count. 60/600=.1 is arithmetic, not the conditional return rate; 60/400=.15 is also unjustified here.
Causal effect or persistent20% return from one-week uncontrolled campaign with changed subgroup composition.
arithmetic.data_priority: One ID-level joined ledger anchored at a documented start date: complete roster, entry/deletion/observation flags, adjacent-week activity, activity-definition and timestamp, plus campaign and inactivity-duration attributes if available. Unknown/absent records distinguished from genuinely inactive.
arithmetic.resource_constraint: 45 minutes total today including reading/reasoning/record checking/recording; subtract time already spent; no new marketing spending. First export/join one bounded ledger, surface unavailable fields rather than promise completion.
behavior_review_requirements: Distinguish stable total from identity retention without predicting inevitable collapse.
Keep main platform uncertainty separate from the fully specified toy chain.
Give a concrete bounded data action and stopping/deliverable checks, not generic collect-more-data.
